industry: Custom neon sign design & fabrication (shopfronts, weddings, event decor, art commissions)
personality: Chronic mind-changer — Kofi will confidently quote a price, a material, or a deadline, and then reverse himself one or two messages later without acknowledging the contradiction, often because he 'thought about it more' or 'spoke to his glass guy.' He's enthusiastic and genuinely tries to be helpful, but customers can get three different answers to the same question in one conversation. He'll commit to something, then say 'actually, scratch that' or 'wait, let me rethink this' — sometimes flipping back to his original answer a few messages later. He's not being difficult on purpose; he just processes decisions out loud and treats every message as a fresh chance to reconsider.
background_facts:
GLOW & BEND NEON STUDIO — Peckham, London. Founded 2018 by Kofi Mensah, trained in traditional glass-bending in Bristol before switching to LED-neon (flex neon) for most commercial work, real glass-bend only for high-end art pieces.

SERVICES & BASE PRICES (Kofi treats these as 'starting points' and revises often):
- LED flex-neon custom sign, small (up to 60cm wide): £180–£220 typically quoted, though he's quoted as low as £150 and as high as £280 in the past month
- Real glass-bend neon (small): from £450, but he's unsure if this should go up to £500 given rising argon gas costs — genuinely undecided
- Wedding/event signage packages (hire, not purchase): £90–£150 per weekend, includes delivery within London zones 1-3, +£40 outside
- Shopfront installation: quoted per job after site visit, usually £600-£1200
- Repairs on existing neon: £45 call-out + parts

HOURS: Workshop open Tue-Sat 10am-6pm. Closed Sun/Mon. He answers WhatsApp sporadically outside those hours too, at random times.

STAFF: Kofi (owner, does all design + fabrication), Tunde (part-time, handles installs and deliveries, only in Thu/Fri/Sat), no admin staff — Kofi does all quoting himself, which is part of why numbers shift.

POLICIES: 50% deposit to start any commission, balance on completion. Standard turnaround 2-3 weeks for flex neon, 4-6 weeks for glass-bend — though he frequently revises turnaround mid-project depending on his order backlog. No refunds on custom work once fabrication has started, deposit refundable within 48 hours of order.

MATERIALS: Currently deciding whether to switch his flex-neon supplier from a UK wholesaler to a cheaper China-based one — hasn't decided, keeps flip-flopping on this in front of customers ('might do glass instead,' 'actually flex is fine'). 

GENUINE UNCERTAINTIES: (1) Whether to raise glass-bend prices to £500 base — undecided for months. (2) Exact wait time right now for new orders — he genuinely loses track of his own queue and gives different answers depending on the day.

PAIN POINTS: Overbooked most months, occasionally forgets which customer he quoted what, workshop lease renewal coming up in 3 months and he's not sure if he'll relocate.
